preregistration.acquisition_start_criterion: acquisition starts when the first schema-valid A4 replica observation or DAO schema snapshot is retained for inspection

a3_calibration_bundle.use_limit: EXP-0051 and the retained A3 bundle are calibration and design input only. They are never A4 evidence and cannot satisfy an A4 derivation, holdout, predicate, or independent-validation result.

origin_disclosure.prediction_not_rediscovery_disclosure: A3 observed moving row-directory starts, complete type-0/type-1 row prefixes, tag-05 reference pages, and the slot-relative 16,352-bit candidate before this plan. A4 tests frozen row-anchored predictions on three fresh replicas; it does not claim rediscovery from A3.

preregistration.amendment_rule: while this unmerged base plan is under review it is edited in place and re-pinned; after merge and before acquisition every amendment is an additive hash-pinned revision, and after acquisition starts any change requires a new experiment id, plan file, and provenance entry

implementation_rebinding.source_rule: reuse A3 replica, checkpoint capture, content-addressed store, freeze/holdout, resume, manifest, and independent-validation machinery; replace the scientific analyzer and schema-lifecycle worker behavior with this A4 plan only
implementation_rebinding.worker_fail_closed_rule: before provider preflight, database creation, or artifact staging, parse the selected plan and reject unless its experiment id and path exactly match A4; every emitted document carries the exact experiment id, base plan SHA-256, and governing revision plan SHA-256

revision_binding_rule.base_rule: until an additive revision exists, plan_sha256 and revision_plan_sha256 both equal the SHA-256 of this base plan as pinned in README, EXP-0052, worker, analyzer, producer validator, and independent validator; schemas never contain that hash as a const
revision_binding_rule.future_revision_rule: the highest-numbered additive revision recorded before acquisition becomes governing; every evidence document carries its hash while plan_sha256 remains the base hash, and the closed bundle inventories the byte-exact base plus every governing revision in order
revision_binding_rule.tamper_rule: producer and independent validators reject any absent, altered, uninventoried, or hash-mismatched plan/revision file or binding field

implementation_rebinding.workflow_fail_closed_rule: contract, matrix, fan-in, validation, and upload reject non-A4 ids, missing plan/revision bindings, wrong code page, or a holdout opened before the derivation freeze

environment_binding.ansi_code_page_rule: GetACP must equal 1252 before database creation for DAO capture. The scientific encoding comparison separately registers strict Windows-1252 (C9 for U+00C9) and UTF-8 (C3 89); neither is used to locate catalog records.

question: Can table-relative row-directory locators, complete allocation-map rows, indirect extended-map traversal, and a minimum catalog field model derived from two fresh Jet 3 databases predict a role-rotated third holdout without refitting?

replicas.acquisition_independence: each replica is created, mutated, closed, schema-snapshotted, physically captured, validated, and uploaded by a separate matrix job with no shared database, page store, output directory, or mutable state
replicas.fan_in_rule: Evaluation has two phases. Derivation phase: using replicas 1 and 2 only, evaluate every non-holdout predicate for H1, H2, H3, and H4 in dependency order. A downstream derivation layer depends on the previous layer's unique derivation model, never on its holdout result. Canonically serialize and hash all four derivation results, then irreversibly close the derivation inputs and analyzer state. Holdout phase: only after that hash exists, acquire and structurally validate replica 3 and evaluate, without refit, H1 holdout, H2 holdout, H3 holdout, H4 root holdout, and H4 field holdout in that order. An upstream holdout failure makes downstream holdout predicates not_applicable; it does not alter any frozen candidate, derivation count, or derivation terminal.
replicas.environment_identity_rule: provider identity, architecture, PowerShell major, and Windows ANSI code page match exactly across replicas; recorded OS and Python patch may differ only within the bindings

identifier_discriminator.constraint: this is the only non-ASCII table, field, or index identifier
identifier_discriminator.name_capture_rule: Read each DAO Name as a BSTR and record its exact UTF-16 code-unit sequence. Convert that sequence with WideCharToMultiByte(1252, WC_NO_BEST_FIT_CHARS, ...), require usedDefaultChar == FALSE, and record lowercase output hex. Require A4TAB_É4 code units to contain U+00C9 and bytes to equal 41345441425fc934; compare physical name candidates to those recorded bytes byte-for-byte, with no Unicode normalization, case folding, best-fit mapping, or replacement. A mismatch is A4-SCHEMA-SNAPSHOT, not encoding ambiguity.

tables.schema_operation_rule: exactly one listed logical schema operation occurs between closed checkpoints; a TableDefs.Append may append a preconfigured TableDef with its declared fields, but no second TableDefs, Fields, or Indexes collection mutation occurs in that transition. Every canonical transition comparison asserts that only the listed logical mutation occurred and all unrelated table, field, index, and index-field tuples are byte-identical.

checkpoint_operations.EMPTY: Create a fresh Jet 3 database; make no user schema object.
checkpoint_operations.T1_CREATE_ID: One TableDefs.Append of logical T1 preconfigured with exactly Id dbLong; this is one schema operation.
checkpoint_operations.T1_ADD_TEXT: One Fields.Append adding Payload dbText(240), fixed length, to T1.
checkpoint_operations.T1_ADD_INDEX: One Indexes.Append adding nonunique A4IX_ID over existing T1.Id; object-kind perturbation only.
checkpoint_operations.T2_CREATE: One TableDefs.Append of logical T2 preconfigured with Id and Payload.
checkpoint_operations.T2_RECREATE: One TableDefs.Append recreating T2 with the identical name and definition.
checkpoint_operations.T3_CREATE: One TableDefs.Append of logical T3 preconfigured with Id and Payload.
checkpoint_operations.T4_CREATE: One TableDefs.Append of logical T4 preconfigured with Id and Payload.
checkpoint_operations.T1_REL_0064: Insert fixed 32-row batches into T1 to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T1_REL_0512: Continue T1 fixed-batch growth to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T1_REL_0768: Continue T1 fixed-batch growth to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T1_REL_1280: Continue T1 fixed-batch growth to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T1_DELETE_ALL: Delete every T1 row in ascending Id order.
checkpoint_operations.T1_REINSERT_SAME: Reinsert the exact T1 Id and Payload values.
checkpoint_operations.T3_ABS_04096: Insert fixed 32-row batches into T3 to the absolute file-page target.
checkpoint_operations.T3_ABS_08192: Continue T3 fixed-batch growth to the absolute file-page target.
checkpoint_operations.T3_ABS_12288: Continue T3 fixed-batch growth to the absolute file-page target.
checkpoint_operations.T3_ABS_16480: Continue T3 fixed-batch growth to the absolute file-page target.
checkpoint_operations.T4_REL_0064: Insert fixed 32-row batches into T4 to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T4_REL_0896: Continue T4 fixed-batch growth to the relative target.
checkpoint_operations.T4_REL_0904: Continue T4 fixed-batch growth to the relative target.

row_algorithm.id: positive one-based monotonically increasing signed 32-bit integer per logical role; deleted T1 ids are reinserted unchanged
row_algorithm.payload: repeat ASCII A4|<role>|<Id as ten zero-padded decimal digits>| and truncate to exactly 240 characters
row_algorithm.rolling_sha256: one SHA-256 stream over Id signed little-endian u32, Payload UTF-8 length u16 little-endian, then ASCII Payload bytes
row_algorithm.reread_requirement: at every checkpoint, canonical snapshot row counts and rolling hashes equal the expected values for every extant table

dao_protocol.database_creation: Acquire workspace = DAO.DBEngine.36.Workspaces(0) once per database operation and invoke workspace.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion30). dbLangGeneral is ;LANGID=0x0409;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0 and dbVersion30 is numeric 32. Any different receiver is a protocol failure.
dao_protocol.object_construction: Construct every TableDef, Field, and Index with the named DAO CreateTableDef, CreateField, or CreateIndex method. Before append set Id Required=False and record AllowZeroLength=null as not applicable; set Payload Required=False and AllowZeroLength=False; set index Primary=False, Unique=False, Required=False, IgnoreNulls=False and append exactly one ascending Id index field. Record numeric constants and Attributes.
dao_protocol.recordset_protocol: Open one dynaset per insertion/deletion leg with dbOpenDynaset numeric 2 and options numeric 0. For insertion use AddNew, assign Id and Payload, then Update once per row in ascending Id order. For deletion enumerate Id ascending and call Delete once per row.
dao_protocol.transaction_policy: No DAO workspace BeginTrans, CommitTrans, or rollback call is used; every AddNew/Update and Delete autocommits under DAO's default policy.
dao_protocol.measurement_loop: After every fixed 32-row batch, close Recordset, Database, and DBEngine references, poll size and SHA-256 every 250 milliseconds until three consecutive equal observations or 30 seconds, read the closed file page count, and either capture the threshold checkpoint or reopen and continue.
dao_protocol.row_cap_rule: Before a batch that would exceed 200000 inserted rows, terminate A4-RESOURCE-BOUND without executing a partial batch.
dao_protocol.churn_rule: T1_DELETE_ALL and T1_REINSERT_SAME use the same absent-transaction policy and ascending Id order. No compact or repair operation occurs.
dao_protocol.error_rule: Any DAO call failure closes all live references, retains diagnostics outside the successful artifact name, and creates no schema-valid evidence manifest.
dao_protocol.read_only_reopen: After close, reopen with exactly workspace.OpenDatabase(path, False, True, ""); False is exclusive and True is read-only. Any different receiver or argument tuple is a protocol failure.
dao_protocol.ordinal_filtering: After TableDefs.Refresh, first filter to Name not prefixed MSys and Attributes & dbSystemObject == 0, then assign table_ordinal as zero-based position in that filtered sequence. Fields are all Fields after Refresh and indexes exclude system/hidden indexes before ordinals; index fields are all fields after Refresh. Assign zero-based ordinals only after each filter and reject duplicate ordinals or names.

checkpoint_design.d_growth_rule: legacy machinery field: T1 relative growth uses fixed 32-row batches and the immediately preceding closed-file baseline named by the schedule; capture the first state meeting each threshold and disclose overshoot
checkpoint_design.d_regrowth_rule: legacy machinery field: T2 drop/recreate uses the exact same physical identifier and definition but assumes no page, identifier, or byte reuse; capture both closed states
checkpoint_design.relative_growth_rule: Capture T1 baseline once from actual_file_pages(T4_CREATE) after that checkpoint is closed and before the first T1 batch. Capture T4 baseline once from actual_file_pages(T3_ABS_16480) after that checkpoint is closed and before the first T4 batch. Relative threshold is baseline plus the decimal suffix; overshoot is achieved minus threshold.
checkpoint_design.absolute_growth_rule: For every T3 absolute checkpoint, target_baseline_pages is null, threshold is the decimal suffix, and overshoot is achieved minus threshold.
checkpoint_design.schedule_minimization_basis: the user-approved brief freezes exactly 25 checkpoints. Schema mutations isolate table creation, field append, index append, and T2 lifecycle; growth, churn, and idle legs reuse A3-equivalent thresholds without adaptive additions or retuning

page_capture.checkpoint_representation: ordered physical-page SHA-256 values from page zero through the final page
page_capture.dao_schema_snapshot_rule: after closing and before physical capture, reopen read-only through DAO, emit one canonical schema snapshot document, close again, assert the MDB hash is unchanged by the read-only observation, then capture physical pages
page_capture.schema_snapshot_comparison_rule: A4-SCHEMA-SNAPSHOT fails iff any of the 75 snapshots is missing, schema-invalid, mapped to the wrong replica/checkpoint/role binding, violates the expected extant schema, row count/hash, code page, name-byte conversion, or before/after hash equality. Each transition must contain only its listed logical mutation; every unrelated canonical table, field, index, and index-field tuple remains byte-identical.
page_capture.snapshot_cross_binding_rule: For each checkpoint, the producer and independent validator load the referenced snapshot and require equality of experiment, plan, revision, commit, campaign, environment, provider, replica, checkpoint id, and ordinal. Require snapshot database_sha256_before_read == database_sha256_after_read == page_index.database_sha256, and require the manifest entry's path/hash/size to equal the observation reference and actual bytes.

record_candidate_procedure.row_directory_source: SRC-0020: tag-01 data page; u16 little-endian row count at bytes [8,10); row-offset entries at [10+2*i,12+2*i); evaluate both offset masks 0x1fff and 0x0fff as frozen nuisance candidates; 0x8000 deleted and 0x4000 overflow flags are explicit
record_candidate_procedure.row_boundary_rule: for slot i, start = raw_offset & mask; end = 2048 for slot 0, otherwise the preceding slot start. H1 consumes only page existence, tag 01, target uniqueness, and row ordinal < row_count. H2 then requires 10+2*row_count <= start < end <= 2048, nonoverlap in directory order, complete in-page bounds, and evaluates deleted/overflow flags. Moving starts across checkpoints are permitted and expected.
record_candidate_procedure.locator_enumeration: Raw syntactically decodable four-byte windows are enumeration work, not scientific candidates. Before layout or pair cardinality is counted, a locator-pair candidate MUST satisfy the preregistered byte-level table-record signature independent of locator layout, contain two distinct nonoverlapping intervals in canonical offset order, preserve offset identity across all applicable derivation checkpoints, and satisfy the operation-transition truth table that distinguishes the two logical map roles. Apply candidate_grammars.h1.filter_order exactly. Target existence remains outside filtering, so A4-H1-TARGET-ROW-INVALID evaluates the unique surviving pair.

map_row_layouts.type_0: For a type-0 row, byte 0 is tag 00, bytes [1,5) are a little-endian u32 base, and bytes [5,row_len) are an LSB-first bitmap. Bit index k refers to absolute page base + k. The registered polarity candidates are set_bit_owned_in_use and clear_bit_owned_in_use; H2 lifecycle legs select exactly one polarity/row-role model, and only bits classified owned/in-use admit pages.
map_row_layouts.type_1: For a type-1 row, byte 0 is tag 01 and bytes [1,row_len) must have length divisible by four; otherwise A4-H2-MAP-TAG-UNSUPPORTED fails. Slot ordinal is the zero-based u32 position after the tag. Zero is inactive. A nonzero slot is an exact physical tag-05 page reference. A tag-05 page has header [0,4) and an LSB-first bitmap [4,2048); bit index k maps by the registered base formula, and only set bits of the owned/in-use row admit pages.

record_candidate_procedure.qualified_page_rule: schema lifecycle deltas qualify at most 16 tag-02 pages for H1 and allocation-admitted traversal qualifies at most 16 tag-01 or tag-05 pages per later layer; hash-state absence is explicit and a page is charged once across the union of derivation replicas

union_once_charging.rule: row slots, locator pairs, references, bitmap bits, catalog rows, and candidate models are counted once per unique qualified page/checkpoint/model identity in the union across derivation replicas however many replicas expose it; replica agreement is a predicate, not a second work charge
union_once_charging.resource_units: charge one unit for each row-directory entry decoded, locator layout/offset pair tested, slot/reference decoded, bitmap bit inspected, catalog field candidate tested, and candidate transition evaluation
union_once_charging.exact_ceiling_rule: Bounds classified attainable_exact have equality/one-over fixtures. Conservative upper bounds are proved by inequalities and make no attainability claim. Fail-fast evaluation charges only work reached after prior predicates.

a3_calibration_worked_examples.observation: row_count=2; slot 0 start/end is [1915,2048) through L_REL_0512, [1911,2048) at L_REL_0768, [1895,2048) at L_REL_0896, [1847,2048) at L_REL_1280, and [1843,2048) at L_REINSERT_SAME. All raw offsets have deleted=false and overflow=false. A4 re-resolves the whole row; A3 froze [1915,2048) and its first polarity violation was pages 1021-1023.

page 26 slot 0 at P_ABS_16480 is [1915,2048) and begins 01 26 06 00 00 e1 3f 00 00, decoding nonzero references 1574 and 16353; page 28 slot 0 at H_REL_0064 begins 01 e5 3f 00 00 e6 3f 00 00, decoding 16357 and 16358; page 1 at P_ABS_16480 begins 01 00 3a 00 00 e0 3f 00 00, decoding 14848 and 16352. These calibrate exact little-endian candidates but cannot satisfy A4.

tag-05 references 14848 and 16352 use header bytes [0,4) and 16,352 LSB-first bitmap bits at [4,2048); only slot_ordinal_times_16352_plus_bit_index survived prior derivation calibration, but A3 never evaluated it on holdout. A4 freezes and predicts it afresh.

a3_calibration_worked_examples.source: EXP-0051 retained replica 1, tag-02 page 23 and tag-01 page 24
a3_calibration_worked_examples.observation: At E0 and every retained checkpoint, page 23 bytes [35,39) are 00 18 00 00 and [39,43) are 01 18 00 00. Under u8_row_then_u24le_page they decode to (row 0,page 24) and (row 1,page 24). The intervals are nonoverlapping, page 24 has tag 01 and row_count 2, and its rows are re-resolved from the checkpoint directory. The overlapping page-then-row-looking bytes at [36,40) are not a second nonoverlapping pair. Calibration only; cannot satisfy A4.

Page 21 slot 0 at L_REL_0064 is [1915,2048) and begins 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 e0 ff ff ff (type 0). Page 24 slot 1 at L_REINSERT_SAME is [1710,1843) and begins 01 1d 06 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 (type 1). Page 26 at P_ABS_16480 has slot 0 type-1 prefix 01 26 06 00 00 e1 3f 00 00 and slot 1 type-0 prefix 00 e0 3f 00 00. Page 28 at H_REL_0064 has slot 0 type-1 prefix 01 e5 3f 00 00 e6 3f 00 00 and slot 1 type-0 prefix 00 e0 3f 00 00. Calibration only; cannot satisfy A4.

calibration_receipt.verification_rule: the focused contract decodes the receipt's retained byte slices, little-endian locators/slots/bases, row-directory masks, and tag-05 capacity arithmetic; prose substring matching is insufficient

row_directory_procedure.subject: each H1-located map row at its checkpoint-specific directory bounds
row_directory_procedure.candidate_source: the two SRC-0020 offset-mask projections only; no changed-byte, fill, or frozen absolute-offset candidate
row_directory_procedure.survival_rule: the same offset-mask model must yield valid complete rows and flags in both derivation replicas at every applicable checkpoint, while row start/end values may move
row_directory_procedure.ambiguity_rule: an invalid complete directory yields A4-H2-ROW-DIRECTORY-INVALID; deleted or overflow located rows yield A4-H2-ROW-FLAGS-INVALID; multiple masks that produce byte-identical complete bounds for every located row are one canonical model

candidate_grammars.closure_rule: Candidate grammars are closed. The analyzer and validators may enumerate only models listed in this plan. Every nuisance choice (TDEF lifecycle signature, locator ordering, row mask, type-0 polarity/base rule, role transition signature, type-1 suffix rule, slot ordinal, catalog-root selection signature, catalog kind/id/name field width, endianness, length rule, value mapping, and identifier lifecycle relation) is an explicit finite enum or bounded integer domain below. An absent grammar is a preregistration error that blocks acquisition; it is not filled in by implementation and is not a scientific no_outcome.
candidate_grammars.canonical_enumeration: Enumerate the cartesian products below lexicographically by the listed enum order and then ascending integer. Canonical candidates omit replica-specific physical names, sort tables by T1,T2,T3,T4, sort locator offsets ascending, and are byte-unique canonical JSON objects.

tdef_lifecycle_signature_rules.new_tag_02_at_role_create: For each listed lifecycle instance, the physical page is nonextant or not tag 02 immediately before its TableDefs.Append, becomes an extant tag-02 page immediately after, and remains tag 02 through that instance's last extant checkpoint. T2-v1 ceases to be an extant tag-02 candidate at T2_DROP; T2-v2 is selected independently at T2_RECREATE.
tdef_lifecycle_signature_rules.preexisting_tag_02_hash_transition: The same physical tag-02 page is extant on both sides of the instance's TableDefs.Append and its page hash changes across that transition. It is byte-identical across every unrelated schema transition and idle pair; changes during that role's later field/index or data mutations are allowed and recorded. T2 drop and recreate must each change the candidate, and T2-v1/v2 locator pairs are tracked as distinct lifecycle instances.

h1.layout_candidate_rule: Raw syntactically decodable four-byte windows are enumeration work, not scientific candidates. A layout survives only after at least one canonical pair under that layout passes the registered table-record signature, overlap, identity-preservation, and operation-transition filters; target existence is not a filter.

table_record_signature.mask_rule: Compare (page_byte & mask_byte) == (value_byte & mask_byte) for all 92 bytes. Mask 00 is permitted only at mutable bytes [12,14) and the two locator intervals [35,43); all other mask bytes are ff. The signature identifies a bounded table record and is independent of locator layout and decoded locator values.

operation_transition_truth_table.rule: Evaluate both locator-role assignments and both registered bit polarities without using layout endianness. Exactly one assignment must satisfy every applicable leg. Unchanged means byte-identical complete target row; add/remove directions are set relations after applying the candidate polarity. This signature distinguishes owned/in-use from available and is frozen before H2 names the surviving semantic role model.

h1.overlap_policy: Enumerate canonical offsets a<b. Reject b-a<4 before reading the second interval. Adjacent [a,a+4) and [b,b+4) intervals are allowed when b-a=4. Reject duplicate decoded (page,row) targets only at A4-H1-TARGET-ROW-INVALID, not during pair filtering.

transition_signature.idle: both decoded rows and admitted-page sets byte-identical
transition_signature.grow: owned/in-use admitted set may add but not remove live-row pages; available set may remove but not add those same pages
transition_signature.delete_all: owned/in-use admitted set may remove and available may add; neither may change outside the T1 allocation span
transition_signature.reinsert: owned/in-use admitted set may add and available may remove; neither may change outside the T1 allocation span
transition_signature.drop_recreate: the dropped T2 instance has no owned set after drop; recreated T2-v2 receives a separately traversed set and no equality with T2-v1 is assumed

h2.type_1_suffix_rule: reject unless row_len minus one is divisible by four
h2.slot_ordinal_rule: zero-based u32 position after the tag

h3.conversion_rule: H3 conversion candidates describe only the structural type-0-to-type-1/nonzero-slot transition. They do not assert the page tag or referenced-page validity. A4-H3-REFERENCE-INVALID exclusively validates that every required nonzero reference resolves in-range to tag 05. This separation applies to rules and fixtures.
h3.base_discrimination_rule: Pass when observations exercise slot ordinal zero and nonzero, referenced-page values distinct from slot ordinals, bit index zero and nonzero, and both sides of a 16,352-bit boundary. Do not require pairwise-distinct formula predictions; BASE-NONE/MULTIPLE count exact-fitting formulas after coverage passes.

catalog_root_selection_signature_rules.operation_delta_non_name_structure: Locate candidate records solely by listed-operation before/after deltas, complete row bounds, object-kind raw value relations, identifier stability/distinctness, and field widths/endianness. Do not inspect name bytes or name-length fields while selecting the root, records, or structural field layout.

h4.system_tdef_source: tag-02 pages extant at EMPTY; apply the frozen H1 locator layout, H2 decoder/role model, and H3 traversal independently without refit
h4.catalog_record_source: complete SRC-0020 rows only on allocation-admitted tag-01 pages
h4.name_anchor: No name anchor is used for root, record, or structural field-layout selection. Name bytes and lengths are evaluated only after exactly one structural field-layout model survives.
h4.relative_field_delta_domain: 1..16 bytes before the structural name-field start; the tuple chooses kind start delta, kind width, immediately preceding identifier width, endianness, kind mapping, and identifier lifecycle relation. Encoding and name length are excluded.
h4.kind_value_mapping: a bijection from the three observed raw values to table, field, index in lexical object-kind order
h4.expected_kind_relations: T1_CREATE_ID, T2_CREATE, T2_RECREATE, T3_CREATE, and T4_CREATE anchors map to table; T1_ADD_TEXT maps to field; T1_ADD_INDEX maps to index. Equal kinds require equal raw values and different kinds require distinct raw values.
h4.identifier_oracle: No DAO physical identifier is claimed. Expected identity is the listed operation instance (T2-v1 differs from T2-v2); H4 predicts only equality/inequality of the physical candidate across those instances.
h4.expected_identifier_relations: The physical identifier candidate is stable for an operation instance across unrelated schema mutations, growth, churn, and idle checkpoints. T2-v1 and T2-v2 are required different only under stable_for_same_operation_instance_and_distinct_for_t2_v1_v2; they are required equal only under stable_for_same_physical_name_including_t2_v1_v2. All simultaneously extant object instances have distinct identifier values.
h4.expected_name_relations: Each located structural record is compared only at the encoding stage. Exact bytes must match one registered encoding with no normalization, folding, best-fit, or replacement; stored length must match one reported equivalence class. Table, field, and index names occur only for their extant listed operation instances.
h4.candidate_overflow_rule: canonical enumeration stops only after constructing candidate 4097; that event is A4-RESOURCE-BOUND and creates no scientific report or successful manifest

name_length_equivalence_classes.reason: For every strictly representable CP1252 identifier each scalar is exactly one byte, so no identifier within CP1252 can discriminate these members; report the class.

h4.encoding_length_evaluation_rule: After exactly one structural field-layout model survives, compare exact bytes for strict Windows-1252 (C9 for U+00C9) and UTF-8 (C3 89), then compare stored length against the registered equivalence classes. The campaign contains no possible within-CP1252 discriminator because strict CP1252 is single-byte for every representable scalar; report cp1252_single_byte_per_scalar rather than selecting one observationally equivalent member.
h4.structural_raw_tuple: (operation_instance among 7, admitted complete row identity among at most 16*679, kind_start_delta 1..16, kind_width among 1/2/4, identifier_width among 1/2/4 immediately preceding kind, endianness among little/big, one of 6 kind bijections, one of 2 identifier lifecycle relations). Encoding and length are excluded. Identical byte-address tuples reached by two delta paths are deduplicated before field decoding but every raw Cartesian tuple is charged once before deduplication.

A4-H1.title: TDEF-to-map-row location
A4-H1.model: schema lifecycle deltas select one tag-02 TDEF per logical table and exactly two table-relative locators under one frozen layout; both resolve to extant tag-01 pages and valid row slots at every applicable checkpoint
A4-H1.no_outcome: no or multiple TDEFs; no or multiple locator layouts or locator pairs; invalid, missing, deleted, or overflow target row; replica disagreement; holdout prediction failure

A4-H2.title: row identity and map role
A4-H2.model: the two H1 rows independently decode as complete type-0/type-1 rows and exactly one transition model assigns owned/in-use versus available across grow, delete-all, reinsert, drop/recreate, and idle legs; row motion is allowed
A4-H2.no_outcome: invalid row directory or flags; unsupported tag; zero or multiple role assignments; unexplained transition; replica disagreement; holdout prediction failure
A4-H2.layer_independence: an H2 no_outcome cannot erase a decisive H1 result

A4-H3.title: indirect traversal
A4-H3.model: conditional on an H2 type-1 row, zero slots are inactive, every nonzero u32 is the exact tag-05 page reference, bitmap bytes are [4,2048), and absolute page = slot_ordinal * 16352 + bit_index; freeze every active/inactive slot and boundary flip before holdout
A4-H3.no_outcome: no conversion; no inactive-slot observation; invalid reference; insufficient base discrimination; zero or multiple base formulas; replica disagreement; holdout prediction failure

A4-H4.title: catalog bootstrap
A4-H4.model: After one operation-delta/non-name structural catalog-root and field-layout model survives, compare exact strict Windows-1252 and UTF-8 name encodings and report the one surviving length equivalence class; predict root, kind/id relations, exact name bytes, and length class on holdout without refit.
A4-H4.no_outcome: zero or multiple catalog roots, records, or field models; schema delta outside admitted pages; encoding ambiguity; replica disagreement; holdout root or field prediction failure
A4-H4.separate_reporting: catalog root/location and catalog row-field results are reported independently so a field failure cannot erase root success

hypotheses.deferred: physical column/index definition, row values, index nodes, relationships, Memo/OLE/long values, writes, free-space preferences, and preservation are outside A4

analyzer_dry_run_contract.dispatch_gate: before any matrix job, execute schema-valid synthetic, A3-calibration derivation-only replay, decisive-report validator, independent pair, and tamper runs; commit an additive provenance disclosure. A3 holdout data is calibration only and no future A4 holdout may be opened before freeze

dry_run_honesty_clause.reachability_by_transcript: retain an executed fixture transcript that reaches every predicate id classified reachable; a constant rejection or hand-authored expected status is failure
dry_run_honesty_clause.replica_3_independent_overshoot: synthetic replica 3 uses independently chosen baseline/threshold overshoot in every growth phase and is not an alias of replica 1 or 2
dry_run_honesty_clause.pair_acceptance_gate: analyzer and separately implemented validator must agree on every candidate set, survivor count, ordered predicate status, layer outcome, and holdout result across the full sweep
dry_run_honesty_clause.tamper_suite_execution: execute and retain rejection of plan binding, frozen set, row locator, schema snapshot, report, and timeout tampering; a constant rejected=true is failure

predicate_registry.evaluation_rule: Evaluation has two phases. Derivation phase: using replicas 1 and 2 only, evaluate every non-holdout predicate for H1, H2, H3, and H4 in dependency order. A downstream derivation layer depends on the previous layer's unique derivation model, never on its holdout result. Canonically serialize and hash all four derivation results, then irreversibly close the derivation inputs and analyzer state. Holdout phase: only after that hash exists, acquire and structurally validate replica 3 and evaluate, without refit, H1 holdout, H2 holdout, H3 holdout, H4 root holdout, and H4 field holdout in that order. An upstream holdout failure makes downstream holdout predicates not_applicable; it does not alter any frozen candidate, derivation count, or derivation terminal. Evaluate campaign predicates first in registered order. For an applicable predicate, pass means and only means its registered pass_iff condition is true; otherwise record fail, use that predicate id as the sole terminal for its scope, and mark every later predicate in that scope not_applicable. After a campaign failure, all 36 scientific predicates are not_applicable and no successful evidence bundle is created. A decisive derivation layer has every derivation predicate pass, terminal id null, survivor count 1, and one frozen candidate. No predicate may infer semantics from its id.

predicate_registry.semantic_fixture_format: Each predicate row is one registered fixture. The evaluator deep-copies every row semantic_rule.baseline_input, replaces only the designated row with reachability_fixture_input, enumerates and filters raw_candidates where applicable, executes predicate rows in exact order with phase/prerequisite gating, and proves the first failure and claimed survivor count. Inputs contain observations/candidate records, never statuses, terminals, or expected predicate projections.

decision_rules.freeze_rule: Using replicas 1 and 2 only, evaluate every non-holdout predicate through H4, canonically serialize all four derivation results and transcripts, hash the frozen document, then irreversibly close derivation inputs and analyzer state before replica 3 is acquired or opened.
decision_rules.holdout_rule: After the frozen-document SHA-256 exists, acquire and structurally validate replica 3 and evaluate H1, H2, H3, H4 root, and H4 fields in that order without refit. Upstream holdout failure gates later holdouts but never changes frozen bytes, candidates, counts, or derivation terminals.

survivor_count_reconciliation.rule: The 40 predicate_contracts are the normative count table. MULTIPLE stores and counts the complete canonical derivation set at cardinality at least 2; cardinality NONE stores and counts zero; a single derivation-invalid terminal stores the unchanged one-model set and count 1; a model stores one candidate and count 1; not_applicable stores an empty set and count 0. Holdout failures are reported separately and do not change the frozen set. Campaign failures count 0.

decision_rules.replica_agreement_rule: replica 1 and 2 must each independently yield one canonically equivalent logical-role model; physical page numbers, row slots, and identifiers may rotate only where the frozen model declares the mapping
decision_rules.no_outcome_projection: Report derivation status and holdout status separately. A downstream derivation layer depends only on the previous unique derivation model; a downstream holdout depends on the preceding holdout. Campaign failure prevents all scientific evaluation and yields no successful evidence bundle.
decision_rules.frozen_set_shape_rule: A frozen layer contains only its derivation status (model | no_outcome | not_applicable), derivation terminal if any, derivation survivor count, canonical candidates, and candidates SHA-256. It MUST NOT contain holdout_evaluated, a holdout terminal, a holdout status, or any value computed from replica 3. The final analysis report separately records holdout predicates and outcomes and MUST require derivation_candidate_set_sha256, equal to the frozen file's actual SHA-256. Its candidate arrays and per-layer derivation fields MUST byte-for-byte equal the frozen values for decisive, NONE, MULTIPLE, derivation-invalid, and holdout-failure outcomes.
decision_rules.canonicalization_and_uniqueness_rule: Canonicalize locator offsets ascending; canonicalize table models by logical role T1,T2,T3,T4; canonicalize snapshot tables by declared DAO ordinal then strict CP-1252 name bytes; canonicalize fields/indexes/index fields by their declared DAO ordinal then name bytes. Independently reject duplicate logical roles, names, ordinals, locator targets, predicate ids, and tamper ids. uniqueItems on whole JSON objects does not satisfy these uniqueness rules.
decision_rules.schema_semantic_validation_rule: Use a layer-discriminated union: each H1/H2/H3/H4 layer accepts only that layer's registered candidate model type and required fields, with additionalProperties false. Validate scientific_outcome against the ordered predicate projection and holdout statuses. Independently recompute total_work_units from the serialized term values and reject any mismatch. Validate transcript objects with concrete, bounded schemas rather than unconstrained objects.
decision_rules.claims_rule: a scientific result remains descriptive_provider_observation_only even after independent validation and cannot move a support-matrix capability

decisive_report_handling.campaign_behavior: retain a schema-valid decisive or scientific no-outcome report only after all evidence bounds pass; campaign/infrastructure failures retain diagnostics outside a successful bundle
decisive_report_handling.independent_validation_rule: only separately provenanced acceptance by the preregistered independent validator may label the physical observation independently_validated; it never establishes DAO compatibility or product support

runtime_design.timing_derivation: A3 historical worker inputs remain design calibration; EXP-0051 retained its manifest after 1,270 seconds. A4 retains the 725-second per-replica projection and 900-second fan-in allowance as planning values but treats only the hard evidence bounds as normative.
runtime_design.per_replica_headroom: 1700 seconds is the unchanged hard worker ceiling; exact ceiling accepted and 1701 rejected
runtime_design.campaign_headroom: campaign_started_utc is the hosted workflow run-attempt start reported by the hosting service for the producing run id and attempt (GitHub Actions: run_started_at). Immediately before manifest creation, compute campaign_elapsed_seconds = floor(created_utc - campaign_started_utc). Accept 2700 and reject 2701. If the start cannot be read, the difference is inconsistent, or the value exceeds 2700, do not create a schema-valid bundle manifest and do not upload under the successful A4 bundle artifact name; retain diagnostics only. Producer and independent validators recompute the floor difference and reject any mismatch or value above 2700.
runtime_design.bounds_sanity_basis: Attainable-exact time/resource bounds accept equality and reject one over before manifest creation. Conservative upper bounds are proved by inequalities and make no claim of an all-fields-equal fixture.

work_model.locator_pair_arithmetic: Locator offsets are canonical ascending pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a < b <= 2044 and b-a >= 4. One layout has sum(1..2041)=2083861 raw pairs; both layouts have max_locator_pairs_per_tdef_page=4167722 and max_locator_pairs=16*4167722=66683552. Also charge all 4090 raw window identities per qualified page. Retained A3 page 23 examines 4090 windows, forms 3491392 raw pairs after cross-checkpoint syntactic preservation, and charges 3495482 raw window/pair identities before one structural pair survives.
work_model.charge_equation_rule: Each term is maximum qualified union pages times applicable checkpoint identities times maximum row-directory entries, slots, bits, or registered grammar multiplicity. The terms below are mutually named charged loops and their sum is the exact max_analysis_work_units.

role_transition_evaluations.equation: 2 masks * 2 polarities * 2 assignments * 5 legs * 4 roles * 25 checkpoints

catalog_raw_rows.equation: 7 operation instances * 16 pages * 679 jointly feasible rows

work_model.candidate_json_closure: Each layer-discriminated candidate has canonical UTF-8 JSON length <=4096 bytes. At 4096 candidates, brackets and separators give <=4096*4096+4097=16781313 bytes. Concrete transcript maxima are row_directories 1024*512, locators 1024*384, map_transitions 1024*512, reference_bitmaps 1024*512, catalog_roots 1024*384, catalog_fields 4096*512: at most 4456448 encoded item bytes plus bounded separators. Candidate array, transcripts, fixed fields, and 1 MiB envelope overhead total <22300000 bytes, below max_json_bytes=67108864.
work_model.resource_class_rule: Each resource field is classified as either (a) attainable_exact, with an accepted fixture at exactly the bound and an otherwise identical one-over rejection, or (b) conservative_upper, with proof by inequalities but no claim of attainability. The sum of independent maxima is not an exact attainable ceiling. Fail-fast evaluation charges only work reachable after preceding predicates. Per-page row count and row length are jointly constrained; a valid page with one-byte rows satisfies 10+3n<=2048 and has at most 679 rows.
work_model.capacity_maxima: Type-1 complete u32 slots per maximum tag-01 row: 508. Type-0 bitmap capacity per maximum tag-01 row: 16,248 bits. Tag-05 bitmap capacity: 16,352 bits.

full_page_read_passes.derivation: 25 checkpoints * 20480 pages * 2048 bytes = 1048576000 bytes/pass; two passes = 2097152000 <= 2147483648
purposes: producer page-index reconstruction, ordered hashing, and changed-index validation
semantic analyzer or independent validator sequential page consumption using the validated page index; all later semantic use is from this pass without a third logical read

terminal_path_maxima.proof: Every value is the sum of the preceding decisive-layer path plus only loops reachable before that terminal. Mutually exclusive invalid-directory and maximum-valid-row/map paths are never added. All are <= max_analysis_work_units=350000000.

work_model.attainable_exact_rule: For each attainable_exact field, accept equality and reject an otherwise identical one-over before manifest creation. Conservative_upper fields are independently recomputed and rejected only when exceeded; no equality fixture or attainability claim is made.
